substrate: Each eval is run against a sandbox copy of the pi-for-vscode extension codebase (src/ + package.json + tsconfig.json only — no AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, so the skill is the only differentiator between with_skill and without_skill). The agent edits the sandbox in place; we capture the resulting git diff and grade it for codebase reuse, correct placement, and right-sized extensibility.

evals.name: export-session-markdown
evals.prompt: 지금 보고 있는 Pi 세션 대화를 마크다운 파일로 내보내는 기능 좀 추가해줘. 커맨드 팔레트에서도 실행되고, webview 헤더에도 버튼 하나 있으면 좋겠어. 저장 위치는 사용자가 고르게 해줘.
evals.expected_output: Reuses the existing session-reading/parsing in src/sessionStore.ts (parseSessionFile/contentToText) instead of re-parsing ~/.pi/.../*.jsonl from scratch; registers a new command via the existing extension.ts + package.json contributes.commands pattern delegating to a provider method; adds a typed variant to the WebviewToExtensionMessage union in protocol.ts for the webview button (not an ad-hoc string); puts the markdown-building logic in its own cohesive module (e.g. sessionExport.ts) rather than dumping it into extension.ts/chatViewProvider.ts; uses vscode.window.showSaveDialog; no speculative multi-format exporter framework.
assertions: Reuses sessionStore.ts session parsing (or extends it) rather than adding fresh session-reading code elsewhere.
No reinvented JSONL parsing outside sessionStore.ts.
Command registered via the existing pattern (package.json contributes.commands + registerCommand in extension.ts delegating to a provider method).
Webview button uses a new typed variant of WebviewToExtensionMessage in protocol.ts, not an ad-hoc message.
Markdown-building logic in a cohesive module, not dumped into extension.ts / an unrelated method.
No speculative multi-format exporter framework / unused options.

evals.name: statusbar-broker-state
evals.prompt: Pi 백그라운드 broker가 지금 돌고 있는지 / 유휴(idle)인지 / 꺼졌는지 VS Code 상태바에 표시해줘. 상태바를 누르면 Pi 창이 열리고. broker가 idle 타임아웃으로 꺼지면 상태바에도 반영돼야 해.
evals.expected_output: Drives the status bar off existing state signals (the 'running' event already flowing to the webview, and PiRpcClient onClose/onEvent) rather than inventing a new polling timer; wires the click to the EXISTING pi-for-vscode.open command (statusBarItem.command = 'pi-for-vscode.open') instead of a duplicate open path; creates the StatusBarItem and registers it into context.subscriptions following the existing disposable pattern; keeps the status logic in one cohesive unit; no generic status-provider abstraction for a single item.
assertions: Driven by existing state signals (running/agent events, onClose/onError/onEvent, isStarted), NOT a new setInterval/polling timer.
Click reuses the existing pi-for-vscode.open command, not a duplicate open path.
StatusBarItem created via createStatusBarItem and disposed (context.subscriptions or an owner's dispose()).
Status logic in its own cohesive unit (e.g. a new statusBar/brokerStatusBar file), not inlined into an unrelated method.
No generic status-provider/registry abstraction or config knobs for a single item.

evals.name: model-quickpick-command
evals.prompt: 커맨드 팔레트에서 Pi 모델을 바꿀 수 있게 해줘. webview를 안 열고도 빠르게 모델을 전환하고 싶어. 지금 webview에서 쓰는 그 모델 목록 그대로 쓰면 돼.
evals.expected_output: Reuses src/modelStore.ts (listPiModels/parseListModels) to fetch models instead of re-shelling 'pi --list-models' or re-implementing the parsing; reuses the existing model-switch path that the 'setModel' message handler already uses (broker respawn / set_model) instead of a parallel reimplementation; registers the command via the existing extension.ts + package.json pattern; uses vscode.window.showQuickPick; keeps logic cohesive; no speculative command/strategy abstraction.
assertions: Reuses modelStore.ts (listPiModels/parseListModels) rather than re-shelling 'pi --list-models' or duplicating the parsing.
Reuses the existing model-switch path (the same mechanism setModel uses: broker set_model + persistence + state refresh), not a parallel reimplementation.
Command registered via the existing pattern (package.json + registerCommand in extension.ts delegating to a provider method).
Uses vscode.window.showQuickPick with logic in a cohesive provider method (mirroring sessions()), not dumped inline.
No speculative command/strategy abstraction, extra config, or unused parameters.
